primary_hypothesis: Greedy equality-coverage selection retains at most16 boards in every one of the six existing1000-board raw pools while preserving exactly the full-pool union of observed equal-digit cell pairs.
primary_decision: Supported on these pools iff all six greedy subset sizes<=16. Falsified if any exceeds16. No population or global Sudoku optimum claim.
cost_label: SELECTION READS ALL1000 COMPLETE LABELS PER BANK. This is a storage/compression result, not learning from the selected subset alone without selection cost.
coverage: For each complete board, the unordered cell pairs with equal digits. Universe is the union observed anywhere in that1000-board pool. No peer graph or geometry enters construction.
greedy: At each step choose the board with maximal newly covered pairs; tie break by smallest original official source-row index. Stop only when union equals the full-pool union.
milp: For each pool minimize sum_b z_b subject to sum_{b covering e}z_b>=1 for every observed pair e, z_b binary. HiGHS1.12.0, one thread, fixed random_seed20261123+seed, greedy feasible warm start, no relative or absolute MIP gap target beyond zero, primal/mip feasibility tolerance1e-9.
budget: At most60 process CPU seconds per seed for the MILP. Single-thread solver wall time_limit55 seconds leaves reporting slack; OS CPU soft limit at solver baseline+60, hard+61. Solve six pools in parallel on Ripper CPU. Timeouts remain reported outcomes.
reporting: Record exact-verified incumbent cover, objective, raw HiGHS dual bound and gap, status, node count, solver wall and process CPU. Distinguish numerical solver bounds from exact combinatorial lower bounds; no optimum claim unless solver closes gap and incumbent independently valid.
counting_bound: Each valid81-cell9-digit Sudoku board has exactly9*C(9,2)=324 equal-digit unordered pairs. A cover of U observed pairs therefore requires at leastceil(U/324) boards. This is exact regardless of overlap.
invariance: Reversing pool order must preserve greedy selected source rows. Independent per-board digit relabelings must preserve all equality coverage. Selected/full support arrays, B0, unit1,tau0,ebar0 must match exactly. Check energies on fixed random boards as a supplemental test.
inference: No fresh GPU search when selected/full energies and settings are byte-identical. Explicitly map to the already audited full-count control per search seed and test cohort; do not claim additional independent inference.
limitations: Selection consumes all1000 labeled solutions and may exploit dataset redundancy.
A finite-pool set cover does not establish a minimum subset among all Sudoku boards.
No row,column,box graph is passed to selection. Geometry is allowed only in the post-selection audit.
BP AdamW is outside this compression study and is not run.
